import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Modules.Sheaf

/-!
# Coherence of native restriction identifications

The native restriction functor is equipped with comparison isomorphisms for
composition, identity, and equality of open immersions.  These elementary
coherences let overlap transition proofs normalize their restriction legs.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules

variable {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}

lemma pullbackCongr_hom_app_eqToHom {φ ψ : X ⟶ Y} (h : φ = ψ)
    (M : Y.Modules) :
    (pullbackCongr h).hom.app M =
      eqToHom (congrArg (fun f => (pullback f).obj M) h) := by
  subst h
  simp [pullbackCongr]

lemma restrictFunctorCongr_rfl_hom_app (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion f]
    (M : Y.Modules) :
    (restrictFunctorCongr (rfl : f = f)).hom.app M = 𝟙 _ := by
  ext U x
  rw [restrictFunctorCongr_hom_app_app]
  exact congr($(M.presheaf.map_id _) x)

lemma restrictFunctorCongr_refl (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion f] (M : Y.Modules) :
    (restrictFunctorCongr (rfl : f = f)).app M = Iso.refl _ := by
  apply Iso.ext
  exact restrictFunctorCongr_rfl_hom_app f M

lemma restrictFunctorCongr_trans {f g h : X ⟶ Y}
    [IsOpenImmersion f] [IsOpenImmersion g] [IsOpenImmersion h]
    (hf : f = g) (hg : g = h) (M : Y.Modules) :
    (restrictFunctorCongr hf).app M ≪≫ (restrictFunctorCongr hg).app M =
      (restrictFunctorCongr (hf.trans hg)).app M := by
  subst g
  subst h
  rw [restrictFunctorCongr_refl, Iso.refl_trans]

lemma restrictFunctorIsoPullback_congr {φ ψ : X ⟶ Y} (h : φ = ψ)
    [IsOpenImmersion φ] [IsOpenImmersion ψ] (M : Y.Modules) :
    (restrictFunctorIsoPullback φ).hom.app M ≫ (pullbackCongr h).hom.app M =
      (restrictFunctorCongr h).hom.app M ≫
        (restrictFunctorIsoPullback ψ).hom.app M := by
  subst h
  rw [pullbackCongr_hom_app_eqToHom, restrictFunctorCongr_rfl_hom_app,
    eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]

/-- Native restriction transport becomes equality transport after comparison
with pullback on both sides. -/
lemma restrictFunctorIsoPullback_congr_eqToIso {φ ψ : X ⟶ Y} (h : φ = ψ)
    [IsOpenImmersion φ] [IsOpenImmersion ψ] (M : Y.Modules) :
    ((restrictFunctorIsoPullback φ).app M).symm ≪≫
        (restrictFunctorCongr h).app M ≪≫ (restrictFunctorIsoPullback ψ).app M =
      eqToIso (congrArg (fun f => (pullback f).obj M) h) := by
  apply Iso.ext
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Iso.app_hom]
  rw [← restrictFunctorIsoPullback_congr h M]
  change ((restrictFunctorIsoPullback φ).app M).inv ≫
      ((restrictFunctorIsoPullback φ).app M).hom ≫ (pullbackCongr h).hom.app M = _
  rw [Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, pullbackCongr_hom_app_eqToHom]
  rfl

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules
